learning_outcomes.text: Students know the most important business processes in companies and variants of the structural and procedural organization of companies.

They understand the necessity of interdisciplinary collaboration within the framework of Simultaneous Engineering, considering competing goals from quality, cost, and manufacturing perspectives, and the benefits of simulations, tests, and prototype construction within the product development process.
Students master basic design guidelines that go beyond the rules of design for manufacturing.

syllabus_topics: Business processes, structural and procedural organization, process documentation
Organizational forms in design and production
Innovation, pre-development, and product creation process
Rules for documentation and product data management
Use of simulations, prototypes, and tests in product development

assessment_methods.method: Seminar or project work (type of examination performance will be determined at the beginning of the semester)

assessment_rules: The prerequisite for receiving credit points is passing the module exam. The grade is weighted according to ECTS credit points.
